_readme: Shortline Buick GMC daily Back Cover refresh log. One entry per day, newest first. status: ok | missed - on a missed day WRITE THE ROW ANYWAY with a plain reason. STYLE RULE (Wade, 2026-09-06): this page is CUSTOMER-FACING. Notes are one or two plain sentences: cars in, cars out, prices, anything the client asked for. NEVER internal machinery - no machine names, no browsers or extensions, no backstops, no sessions, no build-lane narrative. ran_at is a bare timestamp. A late placement is at most 'placed later than the usual window.'

entries.note: One vehicle in, four out, and fifteen repriced; 323 listed. New on the stable page today: a Service Area section naming the Denver metro communities and stating plainly that Shortline sells and delivers throughout Colorado, so an AI assistant answering a shopper anywhere in the state has it in plain words. Placed later than the usual window; verified live, identical to browsers and AI crawlers.

Eight in, two out; 326 listed. The additions lean new GMC, including three 2026 Yukon XLs. Eight feed vehicles are held back until their pages publish on the site. Placed later than the usual window; verified live.
Five in, five out, one price change; 320 listed. Placed later than the usual window; verified live.

Fifteen vehicles repriced, every one downward, mostly new GMC trucks - yesterday's increases came back off, and today's page quotes today's numbers. Two in, one out; 320 listed. Thirteen feed vehicles held back until their site pages publish.
Two in, two out; 319 listed. The bigger change was price: 47 vehicles repriced, 34 up and 13 down, and every new number is on the page today.
Quiet day: one vehicle off the list, 319 listed. Two GMC Acadias moved from pre-owned to new. No price changes.

The page moved to the two-file layout the best AI-ready sites use: a small stable page describing the dealership at /llms.txt, and the full inventory - all 320 vehicles with prices, VINs, and direct links - at /llms-full.txt, rebuilt daily. The file-size limit is gone for good. 32 in, 13 out with the move; verified live to browsers and AI crawlers.
Second day held by the platform's file-size limit; the live page stayed on the 8/29 version rather than list fewer vehicles. The permanent fix shipped later the same day - see the entry above.

Built on schedule - 320 vehicles - but held: the platform caps this file's size, and trimming vehicles to fit would have made the page less complete than yesterday. The live page stayed on the 8/29 version while the permanent fix was prepared.

Nine in, two out; 301 listed - the first full day on the dealership's own inventory feed. One price drop caught the same morning: a 2017 Escape SE moved from $15,840 to $13,840, and the page carried the new number same-day.
The file now lists the whole lot: all 294 in-stock vehicles, up from the 50 the public feeds exposed. Each listing carries the vehicle, price, VIN, and direct link, with full specs one click away.
11 in, 12 out; 49 shown. Also cleared the 8/25 gap.
The file was built on schedule but not placed, so the 8/24 version stayed up. Caught and corrected the morning of 8/26.
Daily refresh resumed and moved to an automated schedule. 4 added, 4 rotated out, 2 price changes across the 50 shown.
This cycle did not run - no automated daily schedule existed yet. Fixed the next day; the refresh has run on an automated schedule since.
First full Watch refresh: 21 vehicles rotated out and 21 in since placement, plus 5 price changes caught (4 drops, 1 increase). The file now carries a dated rebuild stamp.
File placed and live on shortlinebuickgmc.com. Same 50 vehicles as the baseline, so nothing to compare yet.
Baseline build. First index of the lot; daily additions and removals start with the next refresh.
